target.name: Epsilon Indi B
target.notes: Binary T1+T6 brown dwarf system at 3.64 pc. Cleanest unsaturated high-proper-motion benchmark (~4.72 arcsec/yr = ~0.77 SPHEREx px/yr) with 4 observation passes across DR1 and QR3.

scientific_warnings: 180-degree spacecraft roll (SPS_EPA) flip detected across survey passes; all frames have been WCS-reprojected onto a common North-up, East-left TAN grid.

SPHEREx Linear Variable Filters sample a different wavelength per exposure. Compare brightness strictly within the same detector band to distinguish true variability from the star's spectral energy distribution (SED).
Detector core saturation (OVERFLOW / NaN core) detected in 1/8 frames. Visual cores are reconstructed from the 98th-percentile PSF halo; astrometric centroids use halo center-of-mass.
